nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_fire.descript: Grimoire magic: Demon Fire Magic, a sinister black fire that burns through fire resistance, barriers and shadows alike. Its twelve pages hurl flame bullets and exploding bolts, raise pillars and a twister of black flame, turn your body to fire, and end in a rain of falling pillars. Everything it touches keeps burning with the demon burn, and a burning foe can be detonated. Hold your grimoire to cast. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_fire.description: The grimoire of Demon Fire Magic: a black fire that hits as pure magic, so fire resistance and fire immunity do nothing against it. Its pages burn souls, detonate burning foes, raise pillars and twisters, wrap the caster in flame and bring down a rain of black pillars; every hit leaves the demon burn, a pulsing burn that refreshes while the fire spreads. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.demon_fire_st: The first spark of the abyss, a lance of black flame that does not stop for the first thing it meets. Pierces everything on its path for 8 damage (scaled by your existence points) with the strike's own speed and range.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_b: Pitch-black embers spat out like gunfire, one after another. Fires five bullets in quick succession along your sight, 3.5 damage each; every hit sets the demon burn for 3 seconds (1.5 damage a second, ignoring fire resistance).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.soul_scorch: A thread of black fire that eats what armour cannot guard: the soul. A beam to one target within 20 blocks: 6 damage, spiritual damage, burns 8% of its aura and bleeds 4% of its magicules, shreds its resistances with Fragility for 5 seconds, breaks barriers around it and leaves a 5 second demon burn (2 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.ignition_blas: Every flame has a fuse, and this spell lights it. A bolt that bursts on impact in a 3.8 block radius for 7 damage, knockback and a 3 second demon burn. Foes that are already under the demon burn are detonated for 1.8 times the damage and their burn ends.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_p: The ground blackens, and then the sky is held up by a column of fire. Marks the aim point (within 24 blocks) with a 2.5 block ring; after 0.9 seconds a pillar erupts: 10 damage, throws foes upward and sets a 4 second demon burn (2 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.hellfire_wave: A tide of flame rolls out of your hands and does not break on stone or shield. Four surges in 12 blocks of range, 5 damage each, pushing foes back and leaving a 3 second demon burn (1.5 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.flame_step: You are the fire, and fire needs no road. Dash up to 10 blocks forward, burning everything you pass for 5 damage and a 3 second demon burn, and leaving a trail of black flame for 3 seconds that burns anyone who stands in it.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.flame_body: The body gives way to flame, and the flame gives way to nothing. For 10 seconds you are immune to fire, move with Speed II, take 40 percent less damage for 8 seconds, and burn every enemy within 3 blocks for 2 damage every half second with the demon burn.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_t: A spiral of black fire that eats the air and everyone who breathes it. A twister for 5 seconds at the aim point with a 5 block radius: it pulls foes in (not bosses), deals 2.5 damage every half second and keeps them under the demon burn.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_v: A wall of flame that no spell can climb. A ring of black fire around you for 8 seconds, 3.5 blocks wide: it burns whoever touches it for 1.5 damage every quarter second, destroys enemy projectiles and spell barriers that enter it, and gives you Resistance for the duration.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.demon_fire_ap: When the abyss opens, it does not do so politely. Black fire falls in eight pillars across a 10 block area around the aim point (up to 28 blocks away), one after another: each deals 11 damage, throws foes up, bites their spirit and leaves a 6 second demon burn (2.5 damage a second). Barriers in the area are broken.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.cinder_rebirt: What burns can be born again from what is burnt. Once a day: a blast of black fire in a 6 block radius for 12 damage, a 5 second demon burn and a push to every foe; you heal 20 percent of your health plus 2 for each foe caught (up to 5), cleanse poison and wither and gain fire immunity for 20 seconds.
